items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution and is being actively exploited in the wild. It allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on an affected installation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an incorrect authorization flaw that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges, with indications of exploitation in the wild. Other vulnerabilities could lead to arbitrary code execution and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.id: Mirasvit Cache Warmer PHP Object Injection
items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw was found in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: This critical bug allows bad actors to read sensitive files like passwords and encryption keys, modify CMS blocks via the Magento API, and inject malicious Javascript to steal customer data. Combined with another bug (CVE-2024-2961), it can lead to remote code execution and backdoor installation, with active exploitation observed.
